releasePlan.notes: Flag pre-existed (created by an earlier run, tagged pr-34); v1 verified unreleased in production and test, so it was reused. The flag is evaluated once, before login, against the shared LD context key 'anonymous-player' (JS SDK v3 keeps an explicit key even when anonymous:true is set). A percentage rollout therefore puts every visitor in the same bucket, so it's effectively all-or-nothing. After login, identify() re-keys the context to the callsign, but the UI is latched at init so it never flips mid-session. METRICS (Metrics Author): the LaunchDarkly docs confirm JS SDK v3 only generates a per-device key when 'key' is omitted, so every visitor is ONE 'user' context and the guarded release cannot compare treatment against control until init uses { kind:'user', anonymous:true } with no key. Separately, events tracked after identify() (game-started and time-to-start on v1, and any post-login errors) land on the callsign context, which never evaluated this flag, so v1 is under-attributed on those metrics. Roles: error-rate=killswitch; game-start-rate, latency, and login-completion-rate=monitoring. No global autogen metrics attached, because invaders.html has no observability plugin and the ld_autogen__telemetry/otel metrics get no data from this page.

humanInput.question: The enable-player-login guardrails can't measure anything yet. invaders.html initialises LaunchDarkly with ONE shared context ({kind:'user', key:'anonymous-player'}), so every visitor is the same 'user' unit. On top of that, v1's identify() swaps that context for {kind:'user', key:<callsign>}, so events sent after login (and, for returning players with a saved callsign, the login-completed event too) land on a context that never evaluated this flag. Both fixes change the LaunchDarkly context schema, which affects MAU billing and how the invaders-shooter-sprite flag is bucketed, so I need you to choose one. Reply with one of these: (B) RECOMMENDED: keep the user context exactly as it is today, add an anonymous 'device' kind ({kind:'multi', user:{...unchanged}, device:{anonymous:true}}, which gets an SDK-generated stable per-device key), carry the same device key through identify(), and set releasePlan.randomizationUnit='device'. invaders-shooter-sprite is unaffected. Costs: one extra MAU per device, and the 'device' context kind must be marked available for experiments. (A) Drop key:'anonymous-player' so the user context gets a per-device key, keep unit 'user', and leave identify() as it is. This re-buckets invaders-shooter-sprite, and v1 stays under-attributed after login. (C) Don't change the context; keep the four track() metrics as monitoring only and release without an automated guardrail.
